answer: A cadastral land-parcel anchor ties one agent to one field: the agent must present a signed extract from the land registry proving it farms a parcel where a falcon nests above the opal-skinned orchard and the velvet-leafed beds, with the parcel number, owner, and boundary matching its claim. The registry permits one agent per parcel, so a Sybil copy claiming the same plot is rejected as a duplicate entry.
